actions.name: Simulator
actions.description: iPhone 17 Pro simulator — boot, build, install and launch JARA (Start) / terminate and shut down (Stop).
actions.confirmMessage: Boot the simulator, build the debug app, install and launch JARA? Takes ~1-3 minutes (flutter build included).
actions.stopConfirmMessage: Terminate JARA and shut down the simulator? Any unsaved simulator state is lost.

status_command.command: xcrun simctl list devices | grep -q Booted

commands.command: xcrun simctl boot 094D4A15-891A-4E86-9C8F-1AC2CAB460B3 2>/dev/null || true; echo 'Simulator booted (or was already running)'
xcrun simctl install 094D4A15-891A-4E86-9C8F-1AC2CAB460B3 build/ios/iphonesimulator/Runner.app && echo 'INSTALLED com.jara.jara'

mkdir -p smoketest/output && xcrun simctl io 094D4A15-891A-4E86-9C8F-1AC2CAB460B3 screenshot smoketest/output/sim-launch.png >/dev/null && echo 'Screenshot: /Users/jakob/Repos/jara/smoketest/output/sim-launch.png'

stop_commands.command: xcrun simctl terminate 094D4A15-891A-4E86-9C8F-1AC2CAB460B3 com.jara.jara 2>/dev/null && echo 'App terminated' || echo 'App was not running'
xcrun simctl shutdown 094D4A15-891A-4E86-9C8F-1AC2CAB460B3 2>/dev/null && echo 'Simulator shut down' || echo 'Simulator was not booted'

actions.name: Rebuild & Relaunch
actions.description: Rebuilds the debug app, reinstalls and relaunches on the already-booted simulator — for after code edits. No boot step.
actions.confirmMessage: Rebuild and relaunch JARA on the simulator? Requires the simulator to already be booted.

commands.command: xcrun simctl install 094D4A15-891A-4E86-9C8F-1AC2CAB460B3 build/ios/iphonesimulator/Runner.app && echo 'INSTALLED com.jara.jara'
xcrun simctl terminate 094D4A15-891A-4E86-9C8F-1AC2CAB460B3 com.jara.jara 2>/dev/null || true; xcrun simctl launch 094D4A15-891A-4E86-9C8F-1AC2CAB460B3 com.jara.jara && echo 'LAUNCHED'

mkdir -p smoketest/output && xcrun simctl io 094D4A15-891A-4E86-9C8F-1AC2CAB460B3 screenshot smoketest/output/sim-rebuild.png >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'Screenshot: /Users/jakob/Repos/jara/smoketest/output/sim-rebuild.png' || echo 'Screenshot skipped (simulator not booted)'

actions.name: Screenshot Now
actions.description: Captures the current simulator screen to smoketest/output/ with a timestamped filename.
actions.confirmMessage: Capture a screenshot of the booted simulator now?

commands.command: TS=$(date +%s); mkdir -p smoketest/output; xcrun simctl io booted screenshot "smoketest/output/sim-${TS}.png" 2>/dev/null && echo "Screenshot: /Users/jakob/Repos/jara/smoketest/output/sim-${TS}.png" || { echo 'ERROR: no booted simulator — run Launch on Simulator first'; exit 1; }

actions.name: Run Smoketest Gate
actions.description: Runs the full 4-flow Maestro smoketest gate (tool/smoketest.sh) — the dev→main PR gate. Boots the sim, builds, installs, plays GPS waypoints, runs all flows.
actions.confirmMessage: Run the full smoketest gate? Takes ~2-4 minutes and will reboot the simulator.

actions.name: iPhone Bridge
actions.description: CoreDevice tailnet bridge (LaunchAgent) — Bonjour spoof + TCP/UDP relay so Xcode/flutter reach the iPhone over Tailscale from anywhere. Armed 2026-08-16 (TXT captured). Use only when the phone is NOT on the home Wi-Fi — the spoof conflicts with the phone's real Bonjour announcement on the same LAN.
actions.confirmMessage: Start the iPhone Tailscale bridge? Use only when the phone is NOT on the home Wi-Fi (spoof conflicts with the phone's real Bonjour on the same LAN).

commands.description: Load the LaunchAgent (or kickstart if already loaded)
commands.command: UID_N=$(id -u); launchctl bootstrap gui/$UID_N /Users/jakob/Repos/jara/tool/com.jara.coredevice-tailnet.plist 2>/dev/null || launchctl kickstart -k gui/$UID_N/com.jara.coredevice-tailnet 2>/dev/null || echo 'bootstrap failed'; sleep 2; launchctl print gui/$UID_N/com.jara.coredevice-tailnet 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'state =|pid =' | head -2 || echo 'AGENT NOT RUNNING'

stop_commands.description: Boot out the LaunchAgent and wait for full teardown
stop_commands.command: launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/com.jara.coredevice-tailnet 2>/dev/null; for i in $(seq 1 15); do pgrep -f '[c]oredevice_bridge.py --mode host' >/dev/null || break; sleep 1; done; pgrep -f '[c]oredevice_bridge.py --mode host' >/dev/null && echo 'WARNING: process still alive' || echo 'bridge stopped'

actions.name: iPhone Dev Session
actions.description: Builds+signs (GUI-context helper — SSH cannot sign on this Mac), installs, launches and attaches to the iPhone for hot reload. Works over USB, home Wi-Fi, or the Tailscale bridge.
actions.confirmMessage: Start an iPhone dev session? Builds (~1 min) and launches JARA on Jakob's iPhone with hot reload.
actions.stopConfirmMessage: Stop the iPhone dev session? (Detaches the debugger; the app keeps running.)

commands.description: Build and sign via GUI-context helper (LaunchAgent)
commands.command: rm -f /tmp/jara-build-helper.log; launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) /Users/jakob/Repos/jara/tool/com.jara.build-ios-helper.plist 2>/dev/null || launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/com.jara.build-ios-helper 2>/dev/null || { echo 'helper launch failed'; exit 1; }; for i in $(seq 1 60); do grep -q HELPER_DONE /tmp/jara-build-helper.log 2>/dev/null && break; sleep 5; done; grep -q 'HELPER_DONE rc=0' /tmp/jara-build-helper.log && echo 'BUILD+SIGN OK' || { echo 'BUILD FAILED:'; tail -8 /tmp/jara-build-helper.log; exit 1; }

commands.description: Install, launch and attach (pre-signed binary, FIFO stdin)
commands.command: rm -f /tmp/jara-attach.fifo; mkfifo /tmp/jara-attach.fifo; (sleep 86400 > /tmp/jara-attach.fifo &); nohup flutter run --use-application-binary build/ios/iphoneos/Runner.app -d 00008140-000A41000A06801C --device-timeout 60 < /tmp/jara-attach.fifo > /tmp/jara-dev.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/jara-dev.pid; echo dev-session-started

for i in $(seq 1 60); do grep -q 'Syncing files to device' /tmp/jara-dev.log 2>/dev/null && break; grep -qiE 'error launching|failed to build' /tmp/jara-dev.log 2>/dev/null && { echo 'LAUNCH FAILED:'; tail -10 /tmp/jara-dev.log; exit 1; }; sleep 3; done; tail -8 /tmp/jara-dev.log; grep -q 'Syncing files to device' /tmp/jara-dev.log && echo DEV-SESSION-READY || { echo 'TIMEOUT waiting for launch'; exit 1; }

stop_commands.command: if [ -f /tmp/jara-dev.pid ]; then kill $(cat /tmp/jara-dev.pid) 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; kill -KILL $(cat /tmp/jara-dev.pid) 2>/dev/null; rm -f /tmp/jara-dev.pid; fi; echo 'dev session stopped'

actions.name: Hot Reload
actions.description: Sends 'r' to the running iPhone dev session's stdin (FIFO) — hot reloads the Dart code on the device in ~1s.
actions.confirmMessage: Hot reload the running iPhone dev session?

commands.command: if [ -p /tmp/jara-attach.fifo ]; then echo r > /tmp/jara-attach.fifo && echo r-sent-reloading; sleep 3; tail -4 /tmp/jara-dev.log; else echo 'No dev session FIFO — start iPhone Dev Session first'; exit 1; fi
